issues.where: inside the globe, left half and foreground (B-02 crops 3, 5, 6; B-03 crop 9)
issues.what: a large smeared swirl of beige/white streaks wipes out the left of the miniature. The cottage is half erased, the pond and grass dissolve into a radial blur, and it reads as a warp or motion-smear artifact, not as swirling snow or liquid
issues.fix: remove the smear pass. Show disturbance only as discrete particles with depth-correct motion blur, and keep the cottage, fence, pond and grass fully solid behind them

issues.where: the pond in the centre foreground (C-03 crops 10, 11)
issues.what: the pond is a flat opaque cream shape with a hard edge. It has no depth, no transparency and no reflection of the tree, lanterns or sky apart from one lamp-post stripe, so it reads as a paper cutout
issues.fix: make it dark, reflective water with a Fresnel falloff. Reflect the lanterns, tree and lamp, add a thin wet dark rim and a few ripple highlights, or freeze it with clear ice that shows depth

issues.what: the same flat milk-white pond, with no reflection of the lit cottage or lanterns, no depth and no wet edge
issues.fix: same fix as set C: dark reflective water or clear ice with a reflection of the lanterns and a wet margin

issues.where: behind the base at its right shoulder (A-03 crops 9, 12; also in set-B-01 and set-C-03 crop 12)
issues.what: a flat, speckled, dark sand-textured slab with a hard vertical edge stands behind the base like a billboard card. It has no volume and does not join the sand mound
issues.fix: delete the card, or rebuild it as a real sand slope with volume, soft shading and a continuous join to the mound

issues.where: the snow particles inside the globe (A-02 crops 1, 4, 6; A-03 crop 7; set-C-02 crops 2, 3; set-B-01)
issues.what: the snowflakes are identical flat six-point star sprites, many with the same short orange streak. All are sharp, of similar size and at one depth, none are out of focus near the glass or behind the tree, and none have come to rest on the roof, the tree, the grass or the base
issues.fix: use varied 3D flakes with a size spread and depth-of-field defocus near the glass and far behind. Add a light snow cap on the roof, the branches and the grass, and settle flakes on the ground

issues.where: the glass rim at left and right (C-02 crops 1, 5; C-03 crops 8, 9, 12)
issues.what: the edge of the sphere is a mottled grey band with noisy, stone-like texture. It reads as an opaque painted ring, not as clear glass thickness, and the interior just inside the rim is not bent or compressed
issues.fix: render the rim as clean, clear glass thickness with refraction that compresses and bends the interior near the edge, a thin bright edge line and a darker inner line. Remove the noise texture

issues.where: on the dark surface left of the base foot (A-03 crops 8, 10, 11; same in set-B-01)
issues.what: glowing gold filaments with a hot point lie across the surface. There is no source and no physical object, so they read as a stray overlay
issues.fix: remove them, or tie them to a visible source such as a fairy-light wire with bulbs that casts light on the surface

issues.where: the upper right of the base and the sand mound (B-03 crops 11, 12)
issues.what: a fan of frozen sand streaks sprays out like straw or hair strands. They are uniform, hard-edged lines with no grains, and some cross in front of the dark background with no motion logic
issues.fix: remove them, or replace them with falling grains that are mostly round with short, consistent motion blur and a size spread

issues.where: the base band of shells and sea glass (A-03 crops 8, 9, 10)
issues.what: the sculpted sand base reads as soft clay or plastic with uniform grooves. The sea glass is opaque, glossy, candy-like blobs with no translucency or frosting, and the shells sit on the surface like stickers with no seating
issues.fix: give the sand a fine granular texture that catches the light. Make the sea glass translucent and frosted with coloured transmission, and seat each shell in a recess with a contact shadow

issues.where: the surface around the base (A-03 crop 10)
issues.what: the base and the sand mound cast no mirror image on the glossy dark surface, though the bokeh is reflected. The sand also ends on the dark surface without a soft edge
issues.fix: add a reflection of the base and globe that blurs with distance, and soften the edge of the scattered sand

issues.where: near the glass edge at left and right (C-02 crop 5, C-03 crop 8)
issues.what: small flat white ovals float with no glow or depth and read as stray specks
issues.fix: remove them, or make them defocused flakes that match the others

issues.where: the starburst flare at the upper right of the glass (A-03 crop 7)
issues.what: the long, hard star spikes reach well past the sphere into the background and read as a pasted overlay
issues.fix: shorten the spikes and reduce their opacity, and keep the highlight as a soft specular on the glass

issues.where: the edge of the right sand mound (A-03 crop 12)
issues.what: there is a fringe of coloured, chromatic speckle pixels along the sand edge
issues.fix: denoise or clean the edge of the sand mound
